name: Individual Person 38
definition: Human entity, as distinguished from a corporate entity (which is sometimes referred to as an 'artificial person').

NamePrefix.name: Name Prefix
NamePrefix.definition: Term used to address the person.

Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Name by which the party is known and which is usually used to identify that person.

NameSuffix.name: Name Suffix
NameSuffix.definition: Additional information about the person that follows a person's name, for example, qualification such as Doctor of Philosophy (PhD).

BirthDate.name: Birth Date
BirthDate.definition: Date on which the person was born.

CountryOfBirth.name: Country Of Birth
CountryOfBirth.definition: Country where the person was born.

ProvinceOfBirth.name: Province Of Birth
ProvinceOfBirth.definition: Province where the person was born.

CityOfBirth.name: City Of Birth
CityOfBirth.definition: City where the person was born.

Profession.name: Profession
Profession.definition: Name of the occupation or job of the person.

ModifiedPostalAddress.name: Modified Postal Address
ModifiedPostalAddress.definition: Information related to an address to be inserted, updated or deleted.

ModifiedCitizenship.name: Modified Citizenship
ModifiedCitizenship.definition: Citizenship information to be inserted or deleted.

EmployingCompany.name: Employing Company
EmployingCompany.definition: Organisation represented by a person, or for which a person works.

CivilStatus.name: Civil Status
CivilStatus.definition: Civil status of the individual person.

EducationLevel.name: Education Level
EducationLevel.definition: Highest level of education reached by the individual person.

GDPRData.name: GDPR Data
GDPRData.definition: Information about the individual's consent to use personal data under the General Protection Regulation (GDPR) 2016/679 regulation.
